package filestorage

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestPublicationArchiveLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	const fileID = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000123"
	const sourceFileID = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000124"
	archive := []byte("publication-zip")
	sourceArchive := []byte("approved-source-zip")
	var stored []byte
	activated := false
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		switch {
		case request.Method == http.MethodPost && request.URL.Path == "/internal/v1/files/upload":
			reader, err := request.MultipartReader()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("multipart reader: %v", err)
			}
			fields := map[string]string{}
			for {
				part, err := reader.NextPart()
				if err == io.EOF {
					break
				}
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("read multipart: %v", err)
				}
				content, _ := io.ReadAll(part)
				if part.FormName() == "file" {
					if bytes.Equal(content, archive) || !bytes.HasPrefix(content, publicationCipherHeader) || part.FileName() != "snapshot.snapshot" {
						t.Fatalf("unexpected archive upload: filename=%s content=%q", part.FileName(), content)
					}
					stored = append([]byte(nil), content...)
				} else {
					fields[part.FormName()] = string(content)
				}
			}
			for key, expected := range map[string]string{
				"file_kind": "STUDENT_SUBMISSION", "owner_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
				"is_archive": "false", "archive_format": "", "is_temp": "true", "ttl_minutes": "60",
			} {
				if fields[key] != expected {
					t.Fatalf("unexpected %s: %q", key, fields[key])
				}
			}
			responseWriter.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
			_, _ = responseWriter.Write([]byte(`{"ID":"` + fileID + `"}`))
		case request.Method == http.MethodPost && request.URL.Path == "/internal/v1/files/"+fileID+"/activate":
			activated = true
			responseWriter.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		case request.Method == http.MethodGet && request.URL.Path == "/internal/v1/files/"+fileID+"/download":
			responseWriter.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			_, _ = responseWriter.Write(stored)
		case request.Method == http.MethodGet && request.URL.Path == "/internal/v1/files/"+sourceFileID+"/download":
			responseWriter.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			_, _ = responseWriter.Write(sourceArchive)
		default:
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client, err := NewClient(server.URL, "test-token", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{7}, 32)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create encrypted client: %v", err)
	}
	client.HTTPClient = server.Client()
	uploadedID, err := client.UploadTemporaryArchive(
		context.Background(), "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "snapshot.snapshot", archive,
	)
	if err != nil || uploadedID != fileID {
		t.Fatalf("upload publication archive: id=%s err=%v", uploadedID, err)
	}
	if err := client.Activate(context.Background(), uploadedID); err != nil || !activated {
		t.Fatalf("activate publication archive: activated=%v err=%v", activated, err)
	}
	downloaded, err := client.DownloadPublicationSnapshot(context.Background(), uploadedID)
	if err != nil || string(downloaded) != string(archive) {
		t.Fatalf("download publication archive: content=%q err=%v", downloaded, err)
	}
	downloadedSource, err := client.DownloadSourceArchive(context.Background(), sourceFileID)
	if err != nil || string(downloadedSource) != string(sourceArchive) {
		t.Fatalf("download source archive without publication decryption: content=%q err=%v", downloadedSource, err)
	}
}

func TestPublicationDownloadLimit(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		responseWriter.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		_, _ = io.Copy(responseWriter, strings.NewReader(strings.Repeat("x", maxPublicationArchiveBytes+1)))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client, err := NewClient(server.URL, "test-token", base64.RawStdEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{3}, 32)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create encrypted client: %v", err)
	}
	client.HTTPClient = server.Client()
	if _, err := client.DownloadPublicationSnapshot(context.Background(), "file"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("oversized download must fail")
	}
}

func TestPublicationEncryptionConfigurationFailsClosed(t *testing.T) {
	client, err := NewClient("http://filestorage", "test-token", "")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("empty key keeps service startup compatible: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := client.encryptPublicationSnapshot([]byte("code")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("publication must stay disabled when its encryption key is absent")
	}
	if _, err := NewClient("http://filestorage", "test-token", "not-a-32-byte-base64-key"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid configured publication key must fail startup")
	}
}
